query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arrr, me hearties!

Raise yer eyes to the horizon and feel the fire in yer bones! Somewhere beyond these waves lies a treasure chest heavy with gold, jewels, and glory enough to make every soul aboard this ship a legend.

The sea may roar, the winds may howl, and danger may bare its teeth—but we are no timid dock rats! We are pirates! We chase what others fear to seek, and we take what fortune dares to hide!

So hoist the sails, sharpen yer wits, and follow me into the unknown. For tonight, we hunt not just for treasure—but for our names to be carved into the tale of the sea forever!

Now, crew—**to the treasure! Arrr!**
